subject: verbal
format: MCQ, 4 options (أ ب ج د). Official GAT: 120 scored items in 5 sections of 24 mixing verbal and quantitative sections, 125 min total (≈62 s per item on average, derived; ETEC announces per-section time on test day). Verbal share of the test: 55% scientific / 75% theoretical. Pack weights use the scientific-type percentages normalised to the verbal part.

sources.what: Official ETEC GAT guide (الدليل الإرشادي لاختبار القدرات العامة): two test types (theoretical: sharia & business tracks; scientific: general, health, cs_eng tracks); verbal and quantitative domains with % of the whole test per type; concept list per domain; 120 MCQ items in 5 sections of 24; 2 h 05 min; paper and digital; Arabic or English; no calculator; answer options أ/ب/ج/د.

ETEC Qiyas centre page embedding the product 'اختبار القدرات العامة' (updated 2026-09-08): repeats the domain table and percentages, MCQ only, calculator banned, 2 h 05 min, 5 attempts, results valid 5 years.
unverified: split of the analogy share between classic analogy and odd-one-out (75/25) is Darb's choice; ETEC gives no separate percentage for الارتباط والاختلاف.

topics.unit: الجزء اللفظي · التناظر اللفظي (17% علمي / 21% نظري من الاختبار)
topics.notes: Identify the relation in a stem word pair and pick the option pair with the same relation. Relations listed by ETEC: synonymy, contrast, cause-effect, part-whole, category membership, association; also tool-function, degree, place. Mix easy (common words) to hard (rare words, reversed order, near-miss distractors).

topics.unit: الجزء اللفظي · نوع سؤال ضمن التناظر (لا نسبة مستقلة)
topics.notes: Four words, three share a link; pick the different one. Shown as an item type in the official guide's verbal examples but with no separate percentage: allocated 25% of the analogy share here (allocation unverified).

topics.unit: الجزء اللفظي · إكمال الجمل (7% علمي / 13% نظري)
topics.notes: One or two blanks in a short sentence/text; choose the option completing the meaning. Concepts: explicit vs implicit meaning, concrete vs abstract and familiar vs rare vocabulary, best-fit word, in-sentence relations (cause-result, time/place order, negation/affirmation). Medium difficulty; distractors grammatical but off-sense.

topics.unit: الجزء اللفظي · الخطأ السياقي (10% علمي / 16% نظري)
topics.notes: A sentence or short text with four marked words; pick the word that breaks the meaning (not grammar). Concepts: contradiction, critical sense, what context requires, general vs specific and absolute vs restricted words, relations (causality, sequence, contrast, emphasis, complement, comment).

topics.unit: الجزء اللفظي · استيعاب المقروء (21% علمي / 25% نظري)
topics.notes: Original passages (≈150-400 words; science, society, history, culture) with 3-5 questions each. Skills: main idea, similar and opposite meanings, specific ideas, relations and linking, word meaning in context, what a pronoun/demonstrative refers to, inference, best title. Count = questions, not passages.
